timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello my name is Betty. My business is astrology with Betty. I've been a
professional astrologer for 25 years and a student of astrology my entire life.
I'm located on Long Island in New York. I do readings in person. I do them
over the phone. We could do them on FaceTime or Skype. My readings offer
tremendous insight into your soul's journey. I use my vast knowledge of
astrology combined with my gifts of empathy and intuition to assist in
guiding my clients along their unique life path. This offers a deep
analysis since the challenges and the questions you face along the way. My
most popular reading consists of a natal and a trans chart reading. A natal
chart is a snapshot of the sky at the exact moment you took your first breath.
It's at that moment that the heavens created a unique roadmap, an energetic
imprint that upon careful examination reveals extraordinary understanding to
your experiences so far. That combined with a trans chart reading which is
simply a picture of the sky at the moment of our appointment placed over your
personal natal chart reveals where you are now and the opportunities and the
challenges that you're facing. You can expect to leave our session with a
heightened awareness into your psyche, feelings of empowerment and enlightenment as
well as practical skills that you can implement to enable you to live life at
your highest expression. For more information or book reading you can call me
at 888-23 Astro. It's 888-2327876. Or you can check out my website at www.astrologywithbettie.com
where I also offer my start-up blog. That's where I talk about current
planetary trends, the energies and how to best handle them. Thank you for
taking the time to check out this video and I hope to be of service to you soon.
